title: Mystic Figure with Orb and Birds
description: A central hooded figure with a cracked white mask featuring three glowing red eyes holds a cracked spherical orb containing red figures. To the left is a large black raven with a red eye perched on a building labeled "STARS", while a white dove with outstretched wings appears on the right holding lavender sprigs. The background is a purple cosmic scene with a red ringed planet, geometric symbols, and floating buildings.
